about.title: The Lab
about.intro: We are the innovation lab at Universidad Galileo. We build prototypes in artificial intelligence, robotics, electronics, and software, sharing our code, demos, and technical reports.
about.historyIntro: Founded in December 2012 under the direction of Ing. Adrián Catalán, the Lab began as an open experimentation space where researchers and students learn by building working systems.
